x: On the programme was the first of the series of four contests for the Inter-Club Relay Shield, of which we are the holders, and also three club handicaps. In the 4 x 100 yards we started, as we hope to finish, by winning this event, our runners being Tom Wiley, Les Bennett, F.
In the 100 yards there were many absentees and with one heat a walk-over, and some of the others with two or three runners only, we had a final of 5 runners—all “Bels.” F.
It is with deep regret that we have to announce the death of Frank William (Billy) Pritchard. Billy was a Lieutenant in the Anti-Tank Regt. and was killed action in North Africa on November 26th.
Belgrave entries for that meeting included E Gray (100 yds) T D Wiley (100 yds) reserves F W Pritchard and S C Botwright. 440 yds D G Michael, H E Pack, reserves T H Scrimshaw & A A Bird.
